evidence: Applied check-probe-not-in-seed behaviour by hand plus a script: extracted every quoted string from every criterion in all five judge.toml files and substring-searched (case-insensitive) the seed, golden index.html/app.js/server.js, instruction.md and environment/instructions. 'JUDGE' occurs 0 times in seed, solution, instruction or app_context; every created probe (JUDGE-CS0/CS1, W0-W3, L1, M1-M3, WL0/WL1, R0-RX, X0/X1, TE, H0-H3, E1, ME1/ME2, F1/F2, P1-P3, U1-U3, D1/D2, O, LB/LG/LA/LR/LE/LV, T0/T1, Q1-Q6, S0-S2, K1/K2, G1) is absent. All 63 hits are seeded navigation/search targets (e.g. 'Survey booked for Friday.', 'Insurer letter') or app labels ('not available', 'On hold', 'edited', 'new messages') that are expected outputs, not judge-created values. State mutations start from the opposite state in seed_data.json: M-12 timer_days null before persistence sets 30; M-13 30 before timer_changes sets 7; M-11 and M-13 walled [] before Sian/Dev walls; K-17 'Insurer letter acknowledged.' hold true before release; K-18 'Costs estimate sent to Gwen.' has no versions before the edited check; mention negatives (JUDGE-ME1 absent then present then absent) are created in-criterion. Cross-criterion: no earlier criterion changes M-12 timer or walls Sian from M-11, and search probes are not substrings of each other (e.g. 'JUDGE-X0', 'JUDGE-TE', 'JUDGE-O', 'JUDGE-D1' each match only their own messages; 'Hold child JUDGE-H1' does not match 'Hold grandchild JUDGE-H1C'). Search discriminators (100% vs 1000, A_1 vs AB1, X*9 vs XY9) pair a probe with a decoy created in the same criterion. Tried a broken app that pre-renders seed content only: it cannot show any JUDGE value or a 30-day M-12 timer, so it fails; a conforming alternative is not penalised because no criterion expects a probe value to be absent in a state the seed already satisfies. Source-level row; no runtime measurement is required for this check.
